title: Configured Ruff checks fail in the health route module

evidence.quote: from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

reasoning: The project declares Ruff lint and format checks. Running the available equivalent command `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/health.py` reports F401 for the unused `func` and `LLMService` imports and B008 on the FastAPI dependency default used by `get_config`. Running `python -m ruff format --check app/api/health.py` reports that the file would be reformatted, with the long conditional response fields in this route as visible evidence. This is a release/build hazard because the route can pass its runtime test while still failing the configured quality gates.
reproduction: `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/health.py` and `python -m ruff format --check app/api/health.py`. `hatch` was not installed in this environment, so the project wrapper command could not be run directly.
recommendation: Remove the unused imports, run Ruff format on `app/api/health.py`, and either convert FastAPI dependencies in this file to a Ruff-compatible `Annotated[..., Depends(...)]` style or configure Ruff to ignore B008 for FastAPI route modules.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: `tests/test_health.py::test_config` only calls `/api/health/config` and checks for a 200 plus a few response keys; it does not run lint or format checks.
suggestedRegressionTest: Ensure CI runs `hatch run ruff check .` and `hatch run ruff format --check .` alongside pytest for this feature.
minimumFixScope: `app/api/health.py` for unused imports and formatting; either `app/api/health.py` or Ruff configuration for the FastAPI B008 dependency pattern.
